subject: Redwood commercial path & procurement milestones — post-demo recap
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marta Rios <marta.rios@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood commercial path & procurement milestones — post-demo recap

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the demo time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the commercial path and procurement milestones on your side: 

1) Legal review: we can provide a short MPA (attached: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf) and a slim SOW for line-item scoping. Typical internal legal review at Starlite is ~10 business days — can you confirm the correct legal contact?

2) Security assessment: you flagged an info-sec questionnaire. I attached the questionnaire you mentioned (Starlite_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — if your security team prefers, we can run through the answers in a joint session.

3) Finance / procurement: please confirm whether you plan to use PO (preferred for committed capacity) or a corporate card for initial pilot. Aaron in finance was on the demo; if he prefers PO, we'll note approximate PO issuance lead time.

4) Marketplace: you asked about purchasing through the cloud marketplace to speed procurement — that’s possible but will affect billing cadence and contract terms. Let us know if Marketplace procurement is a hard requirement.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- This week: confirm legal + security reviewer names; indicate PO vs card preference; provide any procurement lead times.
- Week 2: deliver signed MPA or marketplace agreement; set target PO issuance date.

I’ve attached a quick SOW draft (SOW-draft.docx) for scope clarity. If helpful I can send a calendar invite for a 30-min procurement coordination call next week (legal + security + finance).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (summary)]
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (stub)]

From: Marta Rios <marta.rios@starlitehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Li <aaron.li@starlitehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial path & procurement milestones — post-demo recap

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the attachments. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Legal: copy to our lead counsel is Lina Park (lina.park@starlitehealth.com). Typical SLT legal window is 7–12 business days, depending on redlines. We will route the MPA to Lina today.

- Security: I’ve attached the completed questionnaire we started — the security team will follow up if they need deeper evidence (logs, SOC2 report). If Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II and a basic data flow diagram, that will speed review.

- Finance / PO vs card: For initial pilot we prefer card to get started quickly, but if we move to committed capacity we will need PO/Procurement (our finance lead Aaron can advise on lead time). Aaron: any estimate on PO issuance once legal signs?

- Marketplace: we are exploring Marketplace for long-term purchasing but it adds delays in contracting. Not a blocker today, but flagging since procurement sometimes prefers it.

We should do a procurement sync next week — Tue or Wed afternoon (ET) works for us.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Rios
Director, Strategic Procurement
Starlite Health
marta.rios@starlitehealth.com

[Attachment: Starlite_partial_security_responses.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood commercial path & procurement milestones — post-demo recap

Vanessa / Neha —

Looping internal ops and solutions so we can be ready for Starlite’s timeline. Notes for internal follow-up: 

- Legal: I'll start a short redline pass on the attached MPA and flag anything non-standard. Aim: return to the customer within 3 business days.

- Security: Neha — can you prepare SOC2 Type II summary and a one-page data flow diagram (PII boundaries + KV cache behavior) that we can share with Starlite? They requested these to accelerate review.

- Billing: if they want PO for committed capacity we'll need to size the initial commitment. Vanessa, can you confirm expected pilot qps and estimated monthly token range so finance can model?

I’ll prepare a tentative mutual action plan spreadsheet and share the link. If we want to propose a calendar slot, suggest Tue 06 Jul 2027 14:00 ET (11:00 PT).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

[Internal note: do not share raw kernel/benchmark VLAN configs — provide aggregate performance figures only.]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marta Rios <marta.rios@starlitehealth.com>, Aaron Li <aaron.li@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial path & procurement milestones — post-demo recap

Hi Marta / Aaron —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We’ll do the following before the sync on Tue 06 Jul: 

- Legal: I asked Karthik to do a first-pass redline; Lina will have the MPA in her queue today. Expect our redline batch by Fri EOD PT.

- Security: Neha will deliver SOC2 summary + data flow by Mon 02 Jul COB PT. Neha: let me know if you need any specific questions from Starlite’s security team.

- Billing / PO: Aaron, if you can share a ballpark PO lead-time (days from signed legal to PO issuance) we’ll capture it in the MAP and set a target PO date. If card is preferred for pilot, we’ll get a pilot order set up immediately.

Attached are two items that should help: 1) Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (clean copy) and 2) a one-page mutual action plan (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GxMp-example-mpa-tracker) — I’ll populate the timeline with the assumptions below.

Assumed timeline (provisional):
- Day 0 (today): MPA to legal, security questionnaire in flight
- Day 3–5: Redwood returns redline & SOC2 summary
- Day 7–12: Starlite legal/security complete review
- Day 10–15: PO issuance (if PO route chosen) or card payment to activate pilot

If all sounds good I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 06 Jul 2027 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET for the procurement sync.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the pilot.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (clean)]
